# OnlineU

> > OnlineU provides comprehensive rankings and directories of accredited online degree programs across all academic levels and disciplines.

OnlineU evaluates online programs using data from IPEDS, NCLEX pass rates, CSWE accreditation, and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics employment outcomes. The site covers programs from major institutions including Southern New Hampshire University, Liberty University, Grand Canyon University, and hundreds of accredited colleges nationwide.

## Key Topics

- Accredited online degrees
- Distance learning programs
- University rankings and reviews
- CSWE-accredited MSW programs
- NCLEX pass rates for nursing
- RN-to-BSN programs
- Social work licensure pathways
- Graduate education programs
- Certificate programs
- IPEDS data and statistics
- Southern New Hampshire University
- Liberty University
- Computer science (Python, Java, C++)
- State-specific program guides

## Main Program Directory

- [2026 List of Accredited Online Degree Programs](https://www.onlineu.com/degrees): Complete directory of accredited online degrees from certificate to doctoral
